Commits from the last good point `53d6896e3e68` to the first bad point `0c94ae85457a`: https://github.com/cplieger/marotte/compare/53d6896e3e689415a482aadbd8f1a938235a81ad...0c94ae85457a16a63306ab8d45946f44a14d476d

Runs of the bad points:

- https://github.com/cplieger/marotte/actions/runs/44550162426
- https://github.com/cplieger/marotte/actions/runs/44551904595

Counts that changed: `settings/x1/chromium/desktop/back/dom` 2599 to 2641, `settings/x1/chromium/desktop/back/max_bytes:GET /api/tools` 14454 to 14825, `settings/x1/chromium/desktop/cold/dom` 2599 to 2641, `settings/x1/chromium/desktop/cold/max_bytes:GET /api/tools` 14454 to 14825, `settings/x1/webkit/phone/back/dom` 2641 to 2599, `settings/x1/webkit/phone/back/max_bytes:GET /api/tools` 14825 to 14454, `settings/x1/webkit/phone/cold/dom` 2641 to 2599, `settings/x1/webkit/phone/cold/max_bytes:GET /api/tools` 14825 to 14454, `settings/x10/chromium/phone/cold/max_bytes:GET /api/engine` 303 to 304.

Before is the cell's baseline, the median of up to 7 earlier good points; After is the latest point. A cell is bad at cpu_ms over 2.0x and more than 250 ms over, server_cpu_ms over 2.0x and more than 10 ms over, heap_mb over 1.25x and more than 2 MB over, rss_mb over 1.25x and more than 50 MB over. This issue closes itself after two consecutive good points; closing it by hand accepts the new values as the baseline.
